assertions.assertion: Registers the handler with AddSamlServiceProvider on the AddAuthentication builder
assertions.rationale: Registers `AddAuthentication().AddSamlServiceProvider("corporate-idp", ...)` — the native Duende SAML SP handler.

assertions.assertion: Sets AllowUnsolicitedAuthnResponse = true and also sets IdpInitiatedCallbackUrl (required when unsolicited responses are allowed)
assertions.rationale: Sets `AllowUnsolicitedAuthnResponse = true` and `IdpInitiatedCallbackUrl = "/ExternalLogin/Callback"`, noting the latter is required.

assertions.assertion: Callback authenticates against the external cookie scheme and reads RelayState from AuthenticationProperties.Items["relayState"]
assertions.rationale: Callback calls AuthenticateAsync against the external cookie scheme and reads `result.Properties.Items["relayState"]`.

assertions.assertion: Warns that RelayState is untrusted input and must be validated before being used as a redirect target
assertions.rationale: Explicitly warns RelayState is untrusted, must never be redirected to directly, and validates it via Url.IsLocalUrl plus an allow-list.
